Name: FS- Layicn's Cute Xianluolipu Rainy Outfit
Author: Layicn
Description:
[center][b]感觉目前n网上的雨衣有点少耶，所以我出手了()[/b]

灵感来源是国内ip暹罗厘普里的五小只 ~
(是的这是中国ip，某邪恶亲友一直以为是外国的ip)
四荤一素是极好的(叉腰)

共有5套服饰:10种帽子，5件上衣

它需要:[color=#ff7700]SMAPI，[color=#ff7700]Fashion Sense[/color][/color]

Q:感觉头套有点不像是雨衣，反而更像是玩偶服耶？
A:(aaaa我绘制的时候也有这种感觉，或许是因为我太注重表现角色了XD)
所以我有制作两种透明度的帽子!
[b][u]Rain[/u][/b](更像是雨衣 (maybe)) 和[b][u]Cute[/u][/b](更像玩偶服)


Xhs:耄耋鱼王Layicn

(这个mod介绍怎么写的这么入机啊真的是)
！！！禁止二传/倒卖/整合我的mod！！！

[b]总之玩的开心拉[/b]

------------------------------------------------------------

The inspiration comes from the IP Xianluolipu,
an original IP from China—I’m obsessed with these 5 characters.

Total 5 clothing sets: 10 hats, 5 tops.

Requires: [color=#ff7700]SMAPI, Fashion Sense[/color].

Q：Maybe these don’t look like raincoats, but more like plush costumes?
A:(Yeah, I felt the same when drawing them,
probably ‘cause I focused too much on portraying the characters XD)
So I made hats with two transparency options!
[b][u]Rain[/u][/b] (more like raincoats (maybe)) and [b][u]Cute[/u][/b]. (more like plush costumes)


[b] Have fun![/b][/center]
